seo.title: Video Scriptwriting | CloudTopia
seo.description: We write video scripts for ads, explainers, and social that hook viewers fast and drive action. Free consultation & demo.

hero.subtitle: Tight, structured scripts for explainers, ads, and social video — built to grab attention in the first seconds and carry viewers to a clear action.

items.title: Strong hooks
items.description: Openers engineered to stop the scroll and hold attention.

items.title: Format-aware
items.description: Scripts shaped for Reels, TikTok, YouTube, or explainer length.

items.title: Action-driven
items.description: Every script ends with one clear, persuasive call to action.

items.title: You own everything
items.description: Code, data, accounts, and documentation stay with you — no lock-in to CloudTopia.

faqs.question: What types of video do you script?
faqs.answer: Explainers, product and ad videos, social shorts (Reels/TikTok/Shorts), and brand films — each structured for its platform.

faqs.question: Do you provide shot or scene direction?
faqs.answer: Yes — scripts can include scene, visual, and tone notes so production runs smoothly.

faqs.question: Do you deliver in Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes — bilingual Arabic + English with full RTL support, so both audiences get a first-class experience.

faqs.question: Do we own the result?
faqs.answer: Completely. You keep the accounts, data, configurations, and documentation. There is no lock-in to CloudTopia.
